description_en: Converts a local disk instance to a cloud-native instance
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore transform-to-ecs --instance-class tair.rdb.1g_tair.rdb.with.proxy.1g --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --engine-version 5.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransformToEcs

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the destination cloud-native instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html.

Note:
For a cluster instance, you must specify a cloud-native cluster instance type that includes with.proxy and specify the ShardCount parameter
parameters.help_zh:
转换目标云原生实例的规格，详细信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html。

这是说明的内容
集群实例需要传入对应云原生带 with.proxy 的集群规格，同时需要指定分片数量 ShardCount 参数
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the destination instance. Valid values:
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.
PrePaid: subscription. If you set this parameter to PrePaid, you must also specify the Period parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要转换到的付费类型，取值：
PostPaid：按量付费。
PrePaid：包年包月，传入本值时，您还需要传入Period参数
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.
This parameter is available and required only when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月的付费时长，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36。
当ChargeType参数取值为PrePaid时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The number of data shards in the cloud-native cluster instance
parameters.help_zh: 云原生集群实例中的数据分片节点的数量
parameters.name: shard_count

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classic instance to be converted
parameters.help_zh: 要做转换的经典实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The Redis-compatible engine version of the instance. Valid values: 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The time when the database switchover is performed after data migration. Valid values: 
Immediately: The switchover is performed immediately after the migration is completed.
MaintainTime: The switchover is performed within the maintenance window.

Default value: Immediately
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移后执行数据库切换的时间，取值： 
Immediately：迁移完立即切换。
MaintainTime：在可维护时间段内切换。

默认值：Immediately
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

This parameter is required only when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。

当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the instance creation operation. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run without creating the cloud-native instance. The system checks the request parameters, request format, service limits, and inventory. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, the instance is created
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建实例的操作执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不创建云原生实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run
